craft_evidence.owned: no — a 1920s Kenosha, WI underwear mill is history; 'manufactured in factories across the globe', 'beyond our own facilities' (/ourcompany/ethicalproduction)
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 79 sampled pages give a country; all say 'Imported'
craft_evidence.heritage: founded 1876 by Reverend Samuel T. Cooper as a hosiery business; Kenosha, Wisconsin mill (/ourcompany/ourstory)

craft_evidence.reasoning: A 150-year house, dated and placed, but every product page says only 'Imported'; no maker, mill or process is named, and the ethics page describes audited third-party factories. Heritage alone: 1.
